<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/reference.mjs. Do not edit: change scripts/api.config.mjs and run "npm run reference". -->

Each line is one endpoint of the API: the call, then the name the library gives it everywhere a method is named (cache settings, events, errors), and on the right what it does and the request it sends.

Methods marked *list* return a request you can await for one page or iterate for all of them, see [Lists](/basics/lists/). The number is the largest page the API accepts, which is the size used when you iterate.

Methods marked *shared* answer the same thing whatever the key, so their result is cached and shared between keys. The others depend on the account and are only cached when you ask, see [Caching](/basics/caching/).

## Account

Explained in [Account](/resources/account/).

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.me()`<br />`me.get` | The account an API key belongs to: username, bio, avatar and last activity.<br />`GET /me` |

## Your quests

Explained in [Your quests](/resources/quests/), [Trading](/resources/trading/).

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.quests.list()`<br />`quests.list` | Every quest of the account, hidden ones included. This is where slugs come from.<br />`GET /quests` |
| `metamob.quests.get(slug)`<br />`quests.get` | The full settings of one of your quests, trade configuration included.<br />`GET /quests/{slug}` |
| `metamob.quests.update(slug, changes)`<br />`quests.update` | Changes settings of one of your quests: character, step, visibility, trade mode and filters.<br />`PATCH /quests/{slug}`, *write* |
| `metamob.quests.monsters(slug, { type, status, trade, step })`<br />`quests.monsters` | The monsters of one of your quests, with quantities and manual trade overrides.<br />`GET /quests/{slug}/monsters`, *list*, 200 per page |
| `metamob.quests.setMonster(slug, monster, quantity)`<br />`quests.setMonster` | Sets how many of a monster you own in a quest.<br />`PATCH /quests/{slug}/monsters/{monsterId}`, *write* |
| `metamob.quests.setMonsters(slug, quantities)`<br />`quests.setMonsters` | Sets the quantities of many monsters at once. More than 200 are split across calls.<br />`PATCH /quests/{slug}/monsters`, *write* |
| `metamob.quests.setTrade(slug, monster, { trade_offer, trade_want })`<br />`quests.setTrade` | Forces how many of a monster a quest offers and wants, or hands it back to the automatic calculation.<br />`PATCH /quests/{slug}/monsters/{monsterId}/trade`, *write* |
| `metamob.quests.matches(slug, { minParallelQuests, onlyPossibleTrades })`<br />`quests.matches` | The best trade partners for one of your quests, ranked like the Community page.<br />`GET /quests/{slug}/matches`, *list*, 50 per page |
| `metamob.quests.zones(slug, { zone, subzone, type })`<br />`quests.zones` | The progress of one of your quests, organised by zone and subzone.<br />`GET /quests/{slug}/zones` |

## Monsters

Explained in [Monsters](/resources/monsters/).

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.monsters.list({ query, type })`<br />`monsters.list` | The monsters, searched by name in French, English or Spanish and filtered by kind.<br />`GET /monsters`, *list*, 200 per page, *shared* |
| `metamob.monsters.get(monster)`<br />`monsters.get` | One monster with the zones and subzones where it lives, and its base monster for an archmonster.<br />`GET /monsters/{id}`, *shared* |

## Zones

Explained in [Zones](/resources/zones/).

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.zones.list({ query })`<br />`zones.list` | The zones of the game, optionally searched by name.<br />`GET /zones`, *shared* |
| `metamob.zones.get(zone)`<br />`zones.get` | One zone with the list of its subzones.<br />`GET /zones/{id}`, *shared* |
| `metamob.zones.subzones(zone, { query })`<br />`zones.subzones` | The subzones of a zone, optionally searched by name.<br />`GET /zones/{id}/subzones`, *shared* |
| `metamob.zones.subzone(subzone)`<br />`zones.subzone` | One subzone with the zone it belongs to.<br />`GET /zones/{id}/subzones/{subzoneId}`, *shared* |
| `metamob.zones.monsters(subzone)`<br />`zones.monsters` | The monsters that can be found in a subzone.<br />`GET /zones/{id}/subzones/{subzoneId}/monsters`, *shared* |

## Other players

Explained in [Other players](/resources/users/).

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.users.search(query, { server, activeWithinDays })`<br />`users.search` | The users with public quests whose name matches a search of 3 characters or more.<br />`GET /users/search`, *list*, 50 per page |
| `metamob.users.get(username)`<br />`users.get` | The public profile of a user, with their public quests.<br />`GET /users/{username}` |
| `metamob.users.quests(username)`<br />`users.quests` | The public quests of a user, with how many monsters each one wants and offers.<br />`GET /users/{username}/quests` |
| `metamob.users.quest(username, slug, { type, status, step })`<br />`users.quest` | The monsters of a public quest, with what its owner wants and offers for each.<br />`GET /users/{username}/quests/{slug}`, *list*, 200 per page |

## Reference data

Explained in [Reference data](/resources/reference-data/).

| Method | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.gameVersions.list()`<br />`gameVersions.list` | The versions of the game: Dofus (Unity), Dofus Retro and Dofus Touch.<br />`GET /game-versions`, *shared* |
| `metamob.gameVersions.get(version)`<br />`gameVersions.get` | One version of the game, from its id or its name.<br />`GET /game-versions/{id}`, *shared* |
| `metamob.servers.list()`<br />`servers.list` | Every game server, with its community and its game version.<br />`GET /servers`, *shared* |
| `metamob.servers.get(server)`<br />`servers.get` | One server, from its id or its name.<br />`GET /servers/{id}`, *shared* |
| `metamob.monsterTypes.list()`<br />`monsterTypes.list` | The three kinds of monsters: monster, boss and archmonster.<br />`GET /monster-types`, *shared* |
| `metamob.monsterTypes.get(type)`<br />`monsterTypes.get` | One kind of monster, from its id or its name.<br />`GET /monster-types/{id}`, *shared* |
| `metamob.questTypes.list()`<br />`questTypes.list` | The kinds of quests: Ochre and Grofus (Dokille), each with its image.<br />`GET /quest-types`, *shared* |
| `metamob.questTypes.get(type)`<br />`questTypes.get` | One kind of quest, from its id, its slug or its name.<br />`GET /quest-types/{id}`, *shared* |
| `metamob.questTemplates.list()`<br />`questTemplates.list` | The quest templates: one per kind of quest and game version, with its number of monsters and steps.<br />`GET /quest-templates`, *shared* |
| `metamob.questTemplates.monsters(template, { step })`<br />`questTemplates.monsters` | The monsters a quest template asks for, with the step each one belongs to.<br />`GET /quest-templates/{id}`, *list*, 200 per page, *shared* |

## Beyond the endpoints

A few methods send no request of their own:

| | |
| --- | --- |
| `metamob.monsters.search(query, { type })` | `monsters.list` with a search, written the short way. |
| `metamob.questTemplates.get(template)` | One quest template, picked out of `questTemplates.list`: the API has no endpoint for it. |
| `metamob.quests.resetTrade(slug, monster)` | `quests.setTrade` with both values handed back to the automatic calculation. |
| `metamob.withKey(apiKey)` | A client for another key, sharing the cache, the listeners and the settings of this one. |
| `data.monster(name)` and the rest of `data` | The reference data that ships with the package, answered from memory. |
